meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: IRS proteins are the adaptors that carry the signal from the insulin/IGF-1 receptor to PI3K. Deplete them and the receptor is still there but the wire is cut.
data.mechanism_beginner: IRS proteins carry the signal from the insulin receptor to PI3K; without them, the receptor is still there but the wire connecting it is cut.
data.boundary: Cell studies (TSC1/TSC2-null mouse cells and human cells) plus a review. An adaptor relationship shown in cultured cells; differences between IRS-1 and IRS-2 by tissue are not resolved by these sources.
